text:
The most serious crime is murder under the depraved-heart theory: firing a gun at a player's leg during a crowded basketball game shows reckless indifference to an unjustifiably high risk to human life, and transferred intent applies that malice to the unintended killing of his teammate. Involuntary manslaughter is too lenient because the conduct rises to malice aforethought.  
CONFIDENCE: 88
